topics.name: Test Run Identity
topics.purpose: Define each concrete verification execution as an explicit identity binding exact suite/case revisions, target revisions, environment profile and execution context.

semantics.identity_rule: Each test run has a distinct execution identity.
semantics.test_rule: Exact test case/suite revision is referenced.
semantics.target_rule: Exact target artifact/runtime/config revision is referenced.
semantics.authority_rule: Running a test does not authorize unrelated production operations.

invariants.rule: Test definitions, fixtures, results, coverage, simulations and release evidence never become production semantic authority or grant production execution rights merely by existing or passing.
Verification evidence binds exact test/profile/source/runtime revisions and declared environment inputs so a pass/fail result cannot silently float across unrelated versions or targets.

hard_gates.condition: test result reused across target versions
run identity reused as test definition identity
test runner gets universal production rights
